_README: Waivers for tests/v2-parity-surface.js. EVERY ENTRY NEEDS A REASON.
This file is the weak point of that guard: an entry added carelessly turns
off a check silently, and the whole reason the guard exists is that seven
missing features reached an officer. Before adding one, prove the claim —
'dead in V1 too' means the name appears in index.html exactly once (the CSS
rule) and is never rendered. Grep it; do not assume.
If you are adding an entry because a feature is not built YET, that is not a
waiver. That is the guard working.

classes.leaflet-control-attribution: Leaflet renders it. Not our markup.
classes.add-row: DEAD IN V1 TOO — appears once in index.html, the CSS rule, with no markup. Verified by grep -c.
classes.add-t: DEAD IN V1 TOO — part of the same unused .add-row block.
classes.add-d: DEAD IN V1 TOO — part of the same unused .add-row block.
classes.add-open: DEAD IN V1 TOO — part of the same unused .add-row block.
classes.jpg: Not a class. Matched out of url("/login-bg.jpg") by the selector regex.
classes.ftoast: V1 shows signature/save errors in a transient toast. V2 shows the same information inline in SignPopup via :sign-error, which persists instead of vanishing after 2.4s — arguably better on a phone in sunlight. The CSS is kept so the toast can be restored without re-deriving it. Same reason as the ftoast id waiver below.

ids.modalRoot: V1's single mount point for string-built modals. V2 renders real components (HydrantDetail, AddHydrantModal, SignPopup) so there is nothing to mount into.
ids.ftoast: V1 shows signature/save errors in a transient toast. V2 shows the same information inline in SignPopup via :sign-error, which persists until dismissed rather than vanishing after 2.4s. Different mechanism, same information, arguably better on a phone in sunlight.
ids.mEmail: RELOCATED, not dropped. V1 shows the signed-in email inside the phone menu. V2 shows it on the Profil tab (#pvEmail), which V1 has no equivalent of, and the menu now links straight to it. Removing it from the menu was the user's call, 2026-08-10, once the tabs moved in there and the menu needed the room. The information is still one tap away and is asserted in T20.
ids.mRole: RELOCATED, not dropped. Same change as mEmail — the role badge now lives on the Profil tab as #pvRole, where it also renders as a coloured badge rather than plain text. Asserted in T22.
